purpose: Determine whether the RX J2129 CLASH field supports an empirical F125W/F814W PSF suitable for the separately frozen BCG plus ICL decomposition.
disclosure: Before freezing the numerical PSF rules, the Molino catalog was queried with the intended point-source, S/N, flag, and magnitude cuts. Three candidate IDs and their approximate catalog FWHM values were seen. No image-stamp PSF, encircled-energy curve, BCG/ICL fit, mass profile, or gravity residual had been measured.

candidate_selection.position_source: Molino x and y detection-frame coordinates, converted from one-indexed to zero-indexed pixels

stamp_and_normalization.combination: pixelwise median after background subtraction, positive clipping, recentering, and per-star aperture normalization

failure_response: If either filter fails, do not loosen these thresholds or fit the BCG without a PSF. Acquire a public exposure-specific HST PSF or freeze a synthetic-PSF protocol.
